title: BYO corpus record — hubspot
description: A HubSpot CRM record (contact, company, deal, ticket, note, …). `object_type` is the grouping unit, because the CRM API is polymorphic over `{objectType}` and supports custom objects. HubSpot's typed fields live in `properties` and are searchable by name; `title`/`content` are the retrieval-facing text a record has no natural body for (a contact is properties, not prose). `associations` link records by doc_id — declare each link once and the loader materialises the reverse direction too.

content.description: The retrieval payload — for a note/email/meeting its body; for a contact/company/deal a readable summary of the record.

title.description: Record display name (contact: full name; company: name; deal: dealname; note/email/meeting: subject).

doc_id.description: Stable id (default: dsid_<sha256(source_type+title+content)>). Association targets reference this.

object_type.description: CRM object type, plural as in the API path (contacts, companies, deals, tickets, notes, emails, meetings, calls, tasks, or a custom object). Default: the source_type.

group.description: ACL group owning this object type (default: slug(object_type)); null means the container owns no group, so nothing is group-scoped to it.

author_email.description: The record owner; served as the record's author/owner principal.

author_name.description: The owner's display name as the corpus writes it, served as the document's owner (a name is not recoverable from an email address).

visibility.description: public = org-wide, group = the object type's group, private = owner only.

readers.description: Explicit reader principals. `user:<email>` / `group:<id>` / `org:<name>` state the type; unprefixed, an address is a user and anything else a group. Overrides visibility — and an EMPTY array means nobody may read the document (admin-only), not everybody.

meta.description: Free-form per-source structured extras merged into the record.

properties.description: HubSpot typed property values, keyed by internal property name (firstname, dealname, amount, …). Search filters can name any of these.

associations.description: Links to other CRM records. Each entry is stored in both directions, as real HubSpot associations are bidirectional.

to_type.description: Object type of the target (default: the target record's own object_type).

type_id.description: HubSpot association type id (default: synthesized per type pair).

archived.description: Archived records are excluded unless the request asks for archived=true.

created.description: createdate (epoch seconds or ISO 8601). Default: synthesized from doc_id.
